definition: Assuming the worst possible outcome will happen, even when there is little evidence to support it.
meaning: my life is over / my future is ruined
examples: If I fail this one subject, I'll never get placed and my entire career is finished.

definition: Measuring one's worth, progress, or intelligence entirely against others, leading to feelings of inferiority.
examples: Everyone around me seems smarter than me honestly.
My cousin got a huge package and I'm still struggling with basics.
All my peers are doing high-tier internships and I have nothing.

definition: Arbitrarily concluding that someone is reacting negatively to you, without bothering to check it out.
examples: Whenever I speak in class, I feel like everyone is laughing at me in secret.
If I ask the professor a question, they will think I'm completely incompetent.
Everyone is judging me because of my grades.

definition: Believing that current struggles are permanent and that nothing will ever improve or get better.
examples: I've failed so many times that I don't see any hope of clearing this paper.
No matter how hard I study, my grades never improve. It's pointless.
I feel trapped in this cycle and I don't think it will ever get better.

definition: Seeing things in black-and-white categories. If a situation falls short of perfect, you see it as a total failure.
meaning: I must be perfect or I am a failure
examples: If I don't get an 8.5+ CGPA, this entire B.Tech is a total waste.
I made one minor syntax error in the code, I'm completely useless.
Since I couldn't finish my study target today, the whole day is ruined.

definition: Assuming that your negative emotions reflect the way things really are: 'I feel it, therefore it must be true.'
meaning: I feel like a failure, therefore I am one
examples: I feel so stupid, so I must not be cut out for engineering.
I feel completely overwhelmed, which means this problem is totally impossible.
I feel so nervous about placements, I know I will never clear any interview.
